# stream sample

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:streamSample`](gmeow-streamSample.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/streamSample>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links a stream to an individual observation, location state, or other entity composing it. Non-functional: a stream typically has many samples, and multiple sampling strategies may coexist for the same stream ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Ordering is implicit via sample timestamps, not asserted list structure ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach each individual sample — an observation, location state, or reading — to the stream it composes; a stream typically carries many.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding sample order as an RDF list or next-pointer chain; order is implicit via each sample's own timestamp ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)). Avoid for the tracked subject ([`gmeow:streamOf`](gmeow-streamOf.md)) or the producing sensor ([`gmeow:streamSensor`](gmeow-streamSensor.md)).

### How to use

- Link each sample with [`gmeow:streamSample`](gmeow-streamSample.md) and give each its own timestamp; the solver layer interpolates a continuous trajectory from the timestamped samples rather than reading an asserted sequence.

### Examples

- ex:roverTrack [`gmeow:streamSample`](gmeow-streamSample.md) ex:fix1, ex:fix2.
